review.why: Models newsletter revenue: paid tiers, a sponsorship rate card, referral loops and a list-growth projection with disclosure checks.
review.summary: Takes list size, open and click rates and the goal, then sizes the sellable audience, builds a paid-subscription model, a CPM or flat-rate sponsorship card, growth loops and a growth-to-revenue projection. Every figure is labeled measured, user-provided or estimated, and a checklist covers ad disclosure, claims and consent.
strengths: Never invents a conversion rate or CPM: missing figures are marked as needing a source
Revenue resting on an assumed rate is never shown as measured
Sponsorships must be labeled as ads
cautions: Written for a large skill suite: memory ledgers, registries and sibling skills are not included
No built-in benchmarks: the user must supply conversion rates and prices
Suite jargon (SEND, D1, EQS) is explained elsewhere
